title: Taiwan tightens security to thwart China's covert grip on medical supply chains
description: Taiwan is tightening national security to prevent Chinese infiltration into its medical logistics sector after reports linked a major firm to China's military and political networks. Officials plan stricter vetting of critical industries, while experts warn Chinese involvement could expose Taiwan's health data and supply chains, Taipei Times reported.

title: China's silent invasion: US Congress warns of China's illegal Indo-Pacific expansion
description: The Chinese Communist Party is accused of a calculated strategy to expand its territorial and maritime claims across the Indo-Pacific without triggering open warfare. Experts warn this "creeping expansion" mirrors Russia's actions in Crimea, with Beijing deliberately staying below the threshold of direct military confrontation. This approach aims to steadily erode regional resistance and weaken Taiwan's resolve.
